_source.note: Atlanta's nearest analogue to Denver's Equity Areas: 15 Neighborhood Statistical Areas identified by a City transportation-equity analysis, split Tier 1 (10, persistent risk) / Tier 2 (5, improving). PLANNING LAYER, NOT A PERMIT TERM -- unlike Denver's Equity Areas it is not known to bind any operator obligation. Nothing here supports a compliance pass/fail until the ATLDOT shared-mobility permit is read.
